name: Sa Sa International Holdings Limited
summary: Sa Sa International Holdings Limited functions as an investment holding company, primarily engaged in the retail and wholesale distribution of a wide array of beauty and cosmetic products. Its operational reach spans across Hong Kong, Macau, mainland China, and Malaysia. The company's extensive product portfolio features approximately 600 brands, covering categories such as skincare, fragrances, makeup, body care, hair care, health and fitness essentials, and modern beauty gadgets. Beyond its core commercial activities, Sa Sa also manages intellectual property rights and property assets, and is involved in charitable endeavors. As of March 31, 2022, the group maintained a network of 234 physical retail outlets. Furthermore, it leverages a robust digital presence for sales, including its proprietary website (sasa.com), a dedicated mobile application, social commerce initiatives, and various third-party e-commerce platforms. Established in 1978, the company's corporate headquarters are located in Chai Wan, Hong Kong.
